title: eludite.browser.tab_select input
description: Make a tab the active tab, the one the other eludite.browser.* tools act on when they are given no `tab`, and bring it to the front. Get ids from eludite.browser.tabs.

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
